messages:
Nina Ford: dropping a quick video of two options for first-run: compact inline toolbar vs full-width onboarding banner. Both should surface quickstarts + sample projects. Quick Q: which pattern reduces cognitive load for new users and is easiest to a11y-test? https://file.mock/redwood/onboard_vid.mp4

Teo Ramirez: Inline feels lighter and keeps the dashboard layout intact. Banner is more discoverable but feels heavier. My concern: banner pushes fold on small screens. Inline -> less layout shift.

Priya Kapoor: From copy POV, we should avoid jargon. Options: 
- Inline primary: "Create project" (short)
- Banner primary: "Get started with a quickstart" (explicit)
Include 1-line helper text under each CTA: e.g., "Spin up a runnable demo in 2 minutes."

Riley (designbot): Accessibility checklist: keyboard focus order, visible focus ring, aria-live only for status changes (avoid announcing non-critical UI), color contrast >=4.5:1 for CTA text. For the inline toolbar, ensure it's announced as a landmark: role=region aria-label=\"Get started\". For banner, make dismiss action reachable via keyboard and expose aria-controls for re-showing.

Nina Ford: Good — we also want to support keyboard users who rely on quick actions. Suggest adding a keyboard shortcut hint: "Press / to open \"Create project\"" in the toolbar. Thoughts?

Teo Ramirez: Shortcut is fine, but make it discoverable only after first render (a small toast) not to overwhelm. Also ensure it doesn't conflict with existing console shortcuts.

Priya Kapoor: Sample project titles (short line + tag): 
- "Embeddings Explorer" — search / similarity demo (tag: demo)
- "Assistant Starter" — chat + tools (tag: starter)
- "Evals Runner" — automated evals + reranking (tag: advanced)
Copy variants for CTA microcopy: 
A: "Create project"
B: "Try a quickstart"
C: "Start an example"
We should A/B test A vs B first.

Riley (designbot): Mobile behavior: toolbar compresses to icon-only row with tooltip on long-press. Banner collapses to a sticky bottom sheet. Both need focusable dismiss. I'll attach updated tokenized components.

Nina Ford: Telemetry: record events: "onboard_shown" (pattern: inline|banner), "onboard_primary_click", "onboard_sample_select", and "onboard_dismiss". Add property "experiment_variant" for A/B. Also funnel: shown -> click -> project_created -> first_run_complete.

Teo Ramirez: Engineering notes: minimal DOM changes for inline path (just insert toolbar node above project list). Banner requires layout change. Prefer iterative launch: ship inline first behind feature flag with experiment.

Priya Kapoor: Acceptance criteria for PR: copy approved, keyboard+screenreader checks pass, contrast >=4.5, telemetry fires, unit test for keyboard focus order.

Nina Ford: Plan: ship inline behind flag, A/B copy test (A vs B), collect N=800 new signups or 10 days. If CTR improves >8% and retention improves, consider banner variant for returning users. Assignments: Teo -> feature-flag impl + tests, Riley -> final tokens + mobile spec, Priya -> copy + analytics schema.

OnboardBot: Created task ONB-389 "First-run inline toolbar experiment: copy + a11y + telemetry" (assignees: Teo, Riley, Priya)
